name: Entrex Carbon Market, Inc
summary: Entrex Carbon Market, Inc., a Boca Raton, Florida-based firm, specializes in radio frequency identification (RFID) technology. Through its subsidiary, Shenzhen Rui Pu Da Electronic Technology Company Ltd, the company is active in the People's Republic of China, where it designs, manufactures, and distributes RFID solutions. Its product line features UHF RFID hardware, including readers, antennas, and various tag types. These advanced RFID systems are deployed across diverse applications such as individual and property security, electronic ticketing, animal tracking, counterfeit pharmaceutical prevention, and efficient warehouse and inventory oversight. Established in 2005, the company operated under the name UHF Logistics Group, Inc. until it officially became Entrex Carbon Market, Inc. on January 6, 2011.
